title: Saffron Leek and Goats' Cheese Mini Pizzas with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
changes_from_base: A soft, buttery leek and onion mixture tinted with saffron replaces the tomato sauce, and crumbled goats' cheese with strips of sun-dried tomato take the place of mozzarella on four small individual bases.
summary: Four individual pizzas topped with saffron-scented sweet leeks and crumbled goats' cheese, decorated with sun-dried tomatoes in a neat spoke pattern.
equipment: large frying pan with a lid

ingredients.item: leeks, white parts only, finely diced (about 6 medium)
fine sea salt or table salt
fine cornmeal or semolina, for dusting
pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature
goats' cheese log, rind removed, crumbled
sun-dried tomato halves in oil, drained and cut into thin strips (or 16 pitted black olives, chopped)

steps.title: Stew
steps.text: Heat 55 g unsalted butter and 15 ml oil in a large frying pan with a lid, add the 180 g finely diced leek whites and the 1 finely chopped medium onion, cover the pan and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until both vegetables are very soft but have not browned.

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Crumble ¼ tsp saffron threads directly into the pan, add ¼ tsp salt, cover again and cook for 10 minutes more, stirring a few times, so the saffron flavour disperses throughout.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Set the oven to 220 °C and dust a large baking tray with 1 tbsp cornmeal or semolina.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide the 340 g dough into 4 equal portions, shape each into a 15 cm circle with a 1 cm raised rim and set them spaced evenly on the tray.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Spread the warm leek mixture evenly across each circle, scatter the 170 g crumbled goats' cheese (rind removed) over the top and arrange the 6 drained sun-dried tomato halves like spokes radiating from the centre (alternatively, scatter 16 pitted black olives in a circle).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Place the tray on the bottom shelf of the oven and bake for about 20 minutes until the edges are lightly browned and the cheese has melted.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Remove from the oven and serve straight away while warm.

tips: Cook the leeks gently and slowly so they turn translucent and sweet without browning or catching on the pan
Rub the saffron threads between your fingers before adding them to the pan to crack the threads and release maximum colour and flavour
Chopped black olives in place of the sun-dried tomatoes give a saltier finish.
storage: Keep leftovers chilled and eat within 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
